title: ViTHSD: Exploiting Hatred by Targets for Hate Speech Detection on Vietnamese Social Media Texts
benchmark_measurement: Detection of targeted hate speech (categorized as clean, offensive, or hate) against the 'religion/creed' target in Vietnamese social media comments.
findings: The 'religion/creed' target had the lowest inter-annotator agreement, suggesting it is a highly subjective category. This target also had the fewest comments in the dataset, leading to severe data imbalance. As a result, the classification model completely failed on this target, misclassifying all instances as 'normal' and achieving no correct predictions for clean, offensive, or hate labels, due to the limitation of training data.
